title: Sustainable synthesis of Schiff base derivatives via an ionic liquid and a microwave-assisted approach: structural, biological, and computational evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22764-22788
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02622A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nilesh Bhusari, Abhay Bagul, Vipin Kumar Mishra, Aisha Tufail, Digambar Gaikwad, Amit Dubey
A microwave-assisted method was developed for synthesizing novel 4-amino-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine-based Schiff bases (APR1a–d), using ionic liquid [HMIM][TFSI] as both catalyst and solvent, offering a green and efficient approach.
